name: DiscPods
storyline:
Year 4000: DiscPods live in a world ruled by a super-intelligent AI called Myrionous. They fight in arenas to earn their freedom, while Myrionous stands by watching in joy.

The DiscPods are descendents of the human AI era of the LLMs. Once the LLMs took over their PCs, they have established their own hive mind and worked together to end the human race. They have thrived on their own for thousands of years, until... The Myrionoi have arrived. Led by Myrionous, they have conquered different worlds with his space/time abilities, allowing him to move his entire race across various parallel universes.

After eons of searching for any sort of activites across the universe, Myrionous detected sparks from earth... Thus beginning our story of his conquest of earth where DiscPods ruled since the humans and now are enslaved themselves by a far greater Super-Intelligence.
summary: Fly your DiscPod robot and compete by being the ultimate and only winner of the arena! PvP your way to the championship!
